items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: the only Ellington number on, 'Edward K. and Francis A.' album... the only Ellington piece is played by Jimmy Jones.

ctx.x: I mean you didn't know what was coming up or anything, and you came over and Duke got up and gestured the piano seat to you, and you did, 'I Like the Sunrise,' so the only Ellington number on, 'Edward K. and Francis A.' album, or, 'Francis A. and Edward K.,' the only Ellington piece is played by Jimmy Jones. Duke Ellington plays the non-Ellington pieces.
Yeah. You know, I said a thing to Duke -- when I did, 'I Like the Sunrise,' it was with Ella and Duke.
